```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(Seurat)
library(speckle)
library(limma)
library(ggrepel)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ggridges)
library(CellChat)

lacols<-c("LA+"="#8DB600","LA-"="#5E4FA2",none="white")

sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"&
              str_detect(sc$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type,"^Ex|Ery",negate = T)))
gc()
sc$has_LA<-ifelse(sc$LA_per_Sample>0,"LA+","LA-")
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_remove(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type," \\(.+"))%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_replace(nosub,"Memmo","Memo")%>%str_remove("Early "))

temp<-read_csv("data/myeloid_subgroups.csv")
aux_table<-sc@meta.data%>%rownames_to_column("barcode")
aux_table<-temp%>%select(barcode,myeloid_cl)%>%
    right_join(aux_table)%>%
    mutate(nosub=ifelse(!is.na(myeloid_cl),
                        myeloid_cl,nosub))%>%
    select(-myeloid_cl)
aux_table<-aux_table[order(match(aux_table$barcode,colnames(sc))),]
#sc$nosub<-NULL
sc<-AddMetaData(sc,metadata = aux_table,col.name = "nosub")

```

## Speckle
```{r}
aux_table<-aux_table%>%filter(str_detect(nosub,"^En|Mes|Smo",negate=T))
props<-getTransformedProps(aux_table$nosub,
                           aux_table$SampleName)
temp<-aux_table%>%distinct(has_LA,SampleName)
designM<-model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=temp)#groups around 
colnames(designM)<-c("LAn","LAy")

props<-props$TransformedProps[,temp$SampleName]
fit<-lmFit(props,designM)
cont<-makeContrasts(LAy-LAn,levels = designM)
fit<-contrasts.fit(fit,cont)
fit <- eBayes(fit, robust=TRUE)
res<-topTable(fit,number = nrow(props),coef = 1)
#res<-res%>%mutate(FC=2**abs(logFC) * sign(logFC))

res<-res%>%filter(cell_type!="Myeloid cells")%>%arrange(logFC)%>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_type")%>%
  mutate(cell_type=factor(cell_type,levels=cell_type))
pB<-res%>%mutate(Class=ifelse(logFC>0,"LA+",
                              "LA-"))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=logFC,y=cell_type,col=Class))+
    geom_point(aes(size=P.Value))+
    geom_segment(aes(xend=0))+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0)+
    scale_color_manual(values=lacols)+theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          #axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,0,0,-4), "mm"))+
  scale_size(range=c(5,1),trans="sqrt",breaks = c(1e-3,1e-2,1e-1))
```

```{r}
bcells<-subset(sc,subset = nosub=="B-cells")
markers<-readxl::read_excel("data/science.adj4857_table_s2.xlsx",sheet = 2,skip=1)

marker_genes<-markers%>%
  filter(!cluster_name%in%c("B14.PB","B15.MZB1+ASC"))%>%
  group_by(cluster_name)%>%slice_max(avg_log2FC,n = 200)
bcells<-ScaleData(bcells,features = i)
bcells<-RunPCA(bcells,features = i)
bcells<-RunUMAP(bcells,dims = 1:5,min.dist = 0.001,repulsion.strength = 3)
bcells<-FindNeighbors(bcells)
bcells<-FindClusters(bcells,algorithm = 4,resolution = .2)

temp<-bcells@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
temp<-as.data.frame(temp)%>%rownames_to_column("barcode")
temp<-bcells@meta.data%>%rownames_to_column("barcode")%>%
  select(barcode,has_LA,seurat_clusters)%>%inner_join(temp)
temp<-temp%>%group_by(seurat_clusters)%>%
  summarise(c1=median(umap_1),c2=median(umap_2))%>%
  right_join(temp)
pC0<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=umap_1,y=umap_2))+
  geom_point(aes(col=has_LA),size=.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values=lacols)+
  geom_text_repel(data=temp%>%distinct(seurat_clusters,c1,c2),

  labs(x="UMAP 1",y="UMAP 2")

marker_genes<-marker_genes%>%split(f = marker_genes$cluster_name)%>%
  lapply(function(x) x$geneSymbol)

res$padj<-p.adjust(res$p)
```

# Differential expression
```{r}
bulk<-AggregateExpression(
  sc,
  assays = "RNA",
  return.seurat = T,
  group.by = c("SampleName","nosub","has_LA"))

#i<-bulk@meta.data%>%count(nosub)%>%
#  filter(n>10)%>%distinct(nosub)%>%
#  unlist()
#all subsets include >100 cells from >10 samples
bulk<-lapply(unique(sc$nosub), function(x) 
  subset(bulk,subset =nosub==x ))
names(bulk)<-unique(sc$nosub)
deg<-lapply(bulk,function(x) 
  FindMarkers(x,group.by="has_LA",ident.1="LA+",
              ident.2="LA-",test.use="MAST",logfc.threshold=0))
deg<-lapply(names(deg),function(x) 
  deg[[x]]%>%rownames_to_column("gene")%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()
#write_csv(deg,"docs/has_laDEG-nosub_bulk-MAST.tsv")

ranks<-split(deg,f = deg$ct)%>%lapply(function(x) 
  x%>%add_count(gene)%>%filter(n==1)%>%arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))%>%
    distinct(gene,avg_log2FC)%>%deframe)

gsea_bp<-lapply(ranks,function(x) 
  gseGO(x,OrgDb = 'org.Hs.eg.db',seed = T,
        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,minGSSize = 50,
        ont = "BP",keyType = "SYMBOL"))
gsea_bp<-lapply(gsea_bp,simplify)

gsea_bp<-lapply(names(gsea_bp),function(x)
  gsea_bp[[x]]%>%as.data.frame()%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()
#gsea_bp%>%write_csv("docs/has_laDEG-nosubbulk-GSEA-BPsimpl.csv")

```

## top genes
```{r}
i<-gsea_bp%>%separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%distinct(ct,core_enrichment)
colnames(i)[2]<-"gene"
subdeg<-deg%>%inner_join(i)

avgLAneg<-AverageExpression(subset(sc,subset = has_LA=="LA-"),
                            group.by = "nosub",assays = "SCT")
avgLAneg<-as.data.frame(avgLAneg$SCT)%>%rownames_to_column("gene")%>%
  pivot_longer(-1,names_to = "ct",values_to = "LA-")
avgLApos<-AverageExpression(subset(sc,subset = has_LA=="LA+"),
                            group.by = "nosub",assays = "SCT")
avgLApos<-as.data.frame(avgLApos$SCT)%>%rownames_to_column("gene")%>%
  pivot_longer(-1,names_to = "ct",values_to = "LA+")
avgs<-avgLAneg%>%inner_join(avgLApos)
write_csv(avgs,"docs/hasLA_nosub_avg.csv")

subdeg<-avgs%>%group_by(ct)%>%
  filter(`LA-`>quantile(`LA-`,.95)|`LA+`>quantile(`LA+`,.95))%>%#0.5 for Th2 cells
  inner_join(subdeg)
subdeg<-subdeg%>%slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC),n=15)
subdeg<-gsea_bp%>%separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%
  mutate(gene=core_enrichment)%>%select(Description,NES,gene,ct)%>%
  right_join(subdeg,by=c("ct","gene"))

subdeg<-subdeg%>%mutate(diff=`LA+`-`LA-`)%>%
  filter((avg_log2FC>0&diff>0&NES>0)|(avg_log2FC<0&diff<0&NES<0))%>%
  select(-c(p_val,pct.1,pct.2,NES))%>%group_by(ct,gene)%>%
  mutate(Description=paste(sort(unique(Description)),collapse = ','))%>%distinct()
```
## b functions
```{r}
temp<-gsea_bp%>%filter(ct=="B-cells")
#i<-c("LRRK2","IL6","STAP1","ITGAM","CCL3")
i<-c("CCL4","TIMP1","STAP1","CDC37","PTPN1","GRB2","BCL11A")#from subdeg+STAP1
pD1<-DotPlot(bcells,features = i,group.by = "has_LA")+coord_flip()+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(1,5))+theme(axis.text = element_text(size=11))

j<-temp%>%separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%
  filter(core_enrichment%in%i)%>%
  select(-core_enrichment)%>%distinct()%>%
  mutate(status=ifelse(NES>0,"LA+","LA-"))%>%
  group_by(status)%>%slice_max(abs(NES),n=5)%>%
  ungroup()%>%distinct(Description)%>%unlist()
j<-j[str_detect(j,"^mac|pepti|hydrol",negate = T)]#drop overlaping functions
j<-c(j,"oxidative phosphorylation")

pD<-gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%j&ct=="B-cells")%>%
    mutate(Description=str_replace(Description,"endoplasmic reticulum","ER")%>%
             str_remove(" pathway"))%>%
    arrange(NES)%>%mutate(Description=factor(Description,
                                             levels = unique(Description)))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=NES,y=Description,col=NES,size=p.adjust))+geom_point()+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(3,5))+theme_bw()+theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

# cell chat
```{r}
cc_res<-readRDS("data/CellChat_PE_hasLA_exclude.rds")

cts<-rownames(cc_res[[1]]@net$`TRUE`$count)
pE<-netVisual_diffInteraction(cc_res[[1]],color.use = alt_cellcols,
                              measure = "count",
                              targets.use = "B-cells",
                              sources.use = cts[str_detect(cts,"Smo|En|Mes|Ery",negate=T)],
                              remove.isolate = T,
                              weight.scale = T)

#top interactions
pairs <- lapply(cc_res[-1],function(x) subsetCommunication(x))
names(pairs)<-names(cc_res)[-1]
pairs<-lapply(names(pairs),function(x) 
  pairs[[x]]%>%mutate(has_LA=x))%>%bind_rows()
temp<-pairs%>%filter(target=="B-cells")
i<-temp%>%separate_rows(receptor,sep = '_')%>%
  distinct(receptor)%>%unlist()
deg<-deg%>%left_join(avgs)
i<-deg%>%filter(ct=="B-cells"&
                  gene%in%i&
                  sign(avg_log2FC)==sign(`LA+`-`LA-`)&
                  abs(avg_log2FC)>.1)%>%distinct(gene)%>%unlist()
j<-temp%>%separate_rows(ligand,sep = '_')%>%
  mutate(gene=ligand,ct=source)%>%distinct(ct,gene)
j<-j%>%inner_join(deg)%>%filter(abs(avg_log2FC)>.1&
                                  (`LA+`>.1|`LA-`>.1))
temp<-temp%>%filter(receptor%in%i&ligand%in%j$gene&
                      annotation!="ECM-Receptor")
#alternative pF
temp1<-netVisual_bubble(cc_res[[1]],
                        sources.use = temp$source,
                        targets.use = temp$target,comparison = c(1,2))
temp1<-temp1$data%>%filter(interaction_name%in%temp$interaction_name)

pF<-temp1%>%
  mutate(dataset=ifelse(dataset=="TRUE","LA+","LA-"))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=dataset,y=group.names,fill=prob))+
  geom_point(shape=21,size=3)+
  facet_wrap(~interaction_name_2,nrow=3,scales="free_y",space="free_y")+
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "B",direction = -1,
                       labels=c("Min","Max"),breaks=c(0.067,0.0815))+
  theme_bw()+theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
                   panel.grid = element_blank())+labs(x="",y="")
```

# CD40 in B cells
```{r}

files<-list.files()
files<-files[str_detect(files,"bg")][-1]#no endometrioma
metadata<-lapply(files,vroom::vroom)%>%bind_rows()
gc()
metadata<-metadata%>%filter(fov_type=="B cells")
mat<-vroom::vroom("endometrium.csv")%>%filter(cell_ID%in%metadata$cell_ID)
mat<-vroom::vroom("PE.csv")%>%filter(cell_ID%in%metadata$cell_ID)%>%bind_rows(mat)
gc()    

mat<-mat%>%column_to_rownames("cell_ID")%>%t()
negavg<-colMeans(mat[c("Ms IgG1","Rb IgG"),])
normi<-t(t(mat)-negavg)
normi<-asinh(normi/5)
nobatch<-sva::ComBat(dat = normi,batch = str_remove(colnames(normi),"c_1.+"),
                     BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 2))

temp<-metadata%>%select(cell_ID,dom_nEndoh1_75,Class,fov_type)
temp<-nobatch%>%t()%>%as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_ID")%>%select(cell_ID,CD40)%>%
  inner_join(temp)
temp<-temp%>%mutate(index=case_when(dom_nEndoh1_75==6~1,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==3~2,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==4~3,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==2~4,
                                    dom_nEndoh1_75==1~6,
                                    TRUE~dom_nEndoh1_75))#as defined in Fig2

domcol <- c( "gray13", "gold2", "lightskyblue2", "darkorange1", "plum4", "maroon")
names(domcol)<-6:1
pF1<-temp%>%mutate(Run_Tissue_name=str_remove(cell_ID,"c_.+"))%>%
  group_by(Run_Tissue_name,index)%>%summarise(CD40=mean(CD40))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=as.factor(index),y=CD40,col=as.factor(index)))+
  geom_violin()+geom_jitter(width = .1)+
  labs(x="Domain",y="Average CD40")+theme_classic()+
  stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",ref.group = 1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=domcol)+theme(legend.position = "n")


metadata<-metadata%>%filter(Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis")
i<-metadata%>%filter(dom_nEndoh1_75==6)%>%distinct(Run_Tissue_name)%>%unlist()
metadata<-metadata%>%filter(Run_Tissue_name%in%i)
nobatch<-nobatch[,metadata$cell_ID]
temp<-metadata%>%filter(fov_type=="B cells")%>%
  select(Run_Tissue_name,cell_ID,fov)
temp<-nobatch%>%t()%>%as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_ID")%>%inner_join(temp)
i<-temp%>%filter(CD40>mean(CD40))%>%count(Run_Tissue_name,fov)%>%
  group_by(Run_Tissue_name)%>%slice_max(n,n=3)%>%select(-n)
```

# Metabolism
```{r}
library(limma)
library(scMetabolism)

sc<-sc.metabolism.Seurat(obj = sc, method = "VISION",
                         imputation = F, ncores = 6, metabolism.type = "KEGG")
#metabo<-sc@
metabo%>%write_csv("docs/scMetabolism_res.csv")

signatures_KEGG_metab <- system.file("data", "KEGG_metabolism_nc.gmt", 
                                     package = "scMetabolism")
signatures_KEGG_metab <- BaseSet::getGMT(signatures_KEGG_metab)
signatureSize<-signatures_KEGG_metab%>%as.data.frame()%>%count(sets)
metabo<-metabo[signatureSize$sets,]

meta<-aux_table%>%mutate(has_LA=ifelse(has_LA=="LA+","T","F"))
meta<-meta%>%split(f = meta$nosub)
metabo<-lapply(meta,function(x) metabo[,x$barcode])
designM<-lapply(meta,function(x) model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=x))
cont<-lapply(designM,function(x) 
  makeContrasts(has_LAT-has_LAF,levels = x))
fit<-lapply(names(meta),function(x) lmFit(log(metabo[[x]]),designM[[x]]))
names(fit)<-names(meta)
fit<-lapply(names(fit),function(x) contrasts.fit(fit[[x]],cont[[x]]))
fit <- lapply(fit,eBayes,robust=TRUE,trend=sqrt(signatureSize$n))
names(fit)<-names(meta)
res<-lapply(fit,topTable,number = 85,coef = 1)
res<-lapply(names(res),function(x) 
  res[[x]]%>%rownames_to_column("pathway")%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()

i<-res%>%filter(str_detect(ct,"En|Mes|Sm|Myel",negate = T))%>%
  drop_na()%>%group_by(pathway)%>%
  summarise(has_LA=ifelse(sum(logFC>0)>sum(logFC<0),"LA+","LA-"),
            blfc=logFC[ct=="B-cells"],i=median(logFC),
            signi=sum(adj.P.Val<0.05))%>%group_by(has_LA)%>%
  slice_max(abs(blfc),n=5)%>%arrange(i)

pH<-res%>%filter(pathway%in%i$pathway&str_detect(ct,"En|Mes|Sm|Myel",negate = T))%>%
  mutate(pathway=factor(pathway,levels=i$pathway),
         )%>%
  ggplot(aes(y=pathway,x=logFC))+geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.1)+
    geom_jitter(aes(col=ct,size= adj.P.Val),height = .1,alpha=0.5)+
    theme_classic()+scale_color_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank())+
    scale_size(range=c(5,1),trans="sqrt",breaks = c(1e-10,1e-2,1))+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0)
```
